notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. The upstream package needs Python 3.10, MuJoCo 3.3.6, IsaacSim 4.5 and an RTX GPU (pyproject.toml, README.md) and was not installed or run where the gate ran, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py) and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gymnasium.make of simple/FrankaTabletopGraspMP-v0 with sim_mode=mujoco) was not run. The physics timestep is 2 ms (the task physics_dt), while one env.step advances MuJoCo to the end of the next render frame at render_hz 30 (a control period of about 33.3 ms); timestep_ms names the physics timestep per FID-015 and the control period is disclosed in the fidelity gaps because the package has no operating_notes field. NOT COVERED: the camera observations of the upstream _get_obs (front_stereo_left/front_stereo_right/side_left are 640x360 and wrist/wrist_left are 480x270); the fake returns and declares only the scalar agent, joint_qpos and eef_pose entries, and the real sizes are named in the driver notes and fidelity gaps. The fake has no MuJoCo dynamics, contacts, domain randomisation, assets or scenes; autoreset=True keeps the conformance suite running after the task's successful grasp terminates an episode. Five warnings are expected from the Gymnasium family bridge: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived inputs (ticks, action.arm[*], and seed on reset and on seed); they were not worked around by declaring actions that would change the family-derived schemas. No Limits are declared: the only input bound is the bridge-derived action space (action.arm is 7 elements in -1.0..1.0, the upstream controller action space at src/simple/robots/controllers/qpos.py:74) and ticks (1..max_ticks). Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests. The device is simulated R0 with no hardware backend; the e-stop is the runtime's software latch only. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
